items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...did you ever really give music lessons like Fess does? ... INTERVIEWEE: At times, you know. But I didn't like it.

ctx.x: Get there. I didn't know much about them then. Did you ever do any teaching?
Teach other trumpet players yourself? Of course a lot of people listen and maybe work with them bands too. But I mean, did you ever really give music lessons like Fess does? Well, at times, yeah.

At times, you know. But I didn't like it. You know. I didn't like it. I didn't like it. Did you travel much except for the boat? Did you ever go to New York or anything else? No, no, no. Well, we traveled, let's see, all parts of Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, Florida. That's the only places we traveled. On a bus or going to train? On a bus, on a bus, yeah. On a bus.
